fieldValues.title: A writer's essays live in a library: a landing page, folders and a bin
fieldValues.move: The editor opens on a library: every essay with its purpose, state and last change, so several essays can be seen and picked at once. Folders are containers that hold essay containers (RFC-034 childContainerIds), so they are arrangement in the records and travel with the repository to any SRS tool; moving an essay moves it between folders. A repository-level bin holds discarded essays until the writer clears it, and clearing never deletes a paragraph another essay still holds (the guard the per-paragraph bin already uses). It works in any SRS repository that holds essays; muSrs is the first.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Shared paragraphs between essays (SP-18, its own remedy) and publishing (SP-75). Search across essays, and nesting deeper than folders of essays.
fieldValues.falsifier: With ten or more essays in use, the writer still opens essays from a dropdown or by repository, or cannot say which essays are in which folder without opening them.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: essays are like files (folders, move, a bin that can be cleared)
fieldValues.return_when: When the owner has kept at least ten essays in folders for two weeks and said whether the library is how they find their work.
